spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): on the financial_connections.session schema, client_secret is a required non-nullable string in v2110 and gains nullable:true while dropping out of the required list in v2120. The same schema backs all four operations (financial_connections/sessions and the legacy link_account_sessions alias, GET and POST), so the four records are projections of one schema change. The property itself survives; only its presence guarantee changed.

fix.migration_guide: client_secret on Financial Connections session responses can now be null (and absent from the required contract). Code that hands it straight to a client-side launch flow, interpolates it, or calls string methods on it can now receive null. The mechanical fix is a null guard at each read site: check for null before passing it to the client SDK launch call, and surface an explicit error or re-create the session when it is missing. No field was removed; only the absent-secret case is now represented as null instead of being guaranteed a string.
